correctness.rationale: Regeneration gives the unique stationary law as the unreset evolution at independent Exp(r) age; even trajectories that have stayed ballistic give densities after mixing the age. The Fourier phase equations give the p₀ transform in the proof. In y=λ² its denominator polynomial at 0, (r+β)²/v², and +∞ has signs +, −, +, ensuring two distinct roots and placing the slow root below the ballistic killing rate in spatial units. The numerator at the slow pole is strictly positive for both reset weights. Hence p₀ has a positive e^(−λ|x|) term and a strictly faster remainder. Independently via the phase Green kernels, p₊ convolves p₀ against (δ/2v)e^(−tu/v) on x−u, u≥0, and p₋ on x+u; the reset sources alone give one-sided e^(−t|x|/v). Multiplying by e^(λx) and using e^(λu) as a bound on the slow contribution proves the coefficients δ/[2(t∓vλ)] times the p₀ tail amplitude, giving both ratios and the reflected left limit. In z=P² the physical equation has F_z<0, and F_R=(1−z)[2R+b+1−3a(R+1)²z]. The positive critical curve z₁ decreases strictly; the second curve z₂=1−3b/[(R+1)(R+2b−1)] increases on R>max(0,1−2b), starting negative and tending to 1. Their single crossing is physical and gives precisely the cubic and admissibility conditions. At R=0 the derivatives give (1+b)/(a+b). For large r the small root y<(r+δ)/D implies v²y/t²→0 and r+δ−Dy=O(1/r), yielding z∼1/(aR). The vanishing endpoints and single critical point imply strict monotonicity on either side. In the unit benchmark the cubic reduces to 3R²+4R−8=0, giving R=(2√7−2)/3 and P²=2/[3(R+1)], consistent with the reported numbers.
residual_risks: The all-parameter conclusion follows analytically, not from numerical Fourier or optimization tests. The endpoints are limits, not assertions of a stationary law at r=0.

value.rationale: A phase-conditioned tail statistic discriminates the direction of motion in an otherwise symmetric stationary model. The same tail composition survives different full-reset preparations even when positional laws differ, and the exact global tuning rule quantifies a nonmonotone effect for every physical parameter choice, distinct from optimizing search time.
